_comment: OpenAI first-party wire. The api-key Connection defaults new Models to public Responses; legacy GPT-3/GPT-4 and chat-audio families keep Chat Completions. These are inferred defaults, not per-Model verification. The subscription Connection is ChatGPT Codex Responses for every Model. Chat Completions accepts reasoning_effort 'none', wants explicit non-strict Tool schemas and carries images, wav/mp3 audio and PDF documents. Public Responses carries images and PDF documents and treats unknown reasoning support as supported. Codex rejects every optional parameter (so no output limit is budgeted), carries images only and never receives the 'none' effort.

family_defaults.note: New Platform Models inherit the current Responses contract and latest general reasoning ladder. Concrete catalog efforts and explicit exceptions still win. Inferred from the official Model catalog and GPT-6.1 Sol, 2026-10-15; not a live verification of new ids.
Preserve established non-reasoning legacy chat routes, including dated snapshots and fine-tunes. An explicit catalog reasoning capability overrides this family inference.
The official GPT-Audio Model contract is non-reasoning Chat Completions with text/audio input and output. New audio variants inherit that route below explicit catalog capability facts.

rules.note: Public Responses GPT-6 Models (not pro) take a configuration_update input item that switches the effort mid-conversation, so an effort change keeps the prompt cache. Documented, not verified live; a rejection is learned and turns the updates off.

gpt-5.2.note: Preserve the existing GPT-5.2 effort floor when its catalog carries no ladder; newer Platform defaults must not silently widen this legacy target.

gpt-5.6.note: Public reasoning guidance documents reasoning.context all_turns for GPT-5.6; it is not sent on Codex.

gpt-5.6-luna.note: Preserve the legacy Codex off rendering; new subscription Models inherit the current low effort default.

gpt-5.6-sol.note: Preserve the legacy Codex off rendering; new subscription Models inherit the current low effort default.

gpt-5.6-terra.note: Preserve the legacy Codex off rendering; new subscription Models inherit the current low effort default.

gpt-6-astra.note: Codex rejected effort none with HTTP 400 on 2026-09-10; off asks for the lowest accepted effort.

gpt-6-luna.note: Chat Completions restricts function calling to effort none, so the Platform uses Responses. Codex support for none is unverified; off is low there.

gpt-6-sol.note: Chat Completions restricts function calling to effort none, so the Platform uses Responses. Codex support for none is unverified; off is low there.

gpt-6.1-sol.note: The ladder is low..max; Codex rejected none and minimal with HTTP 400 on 2026-10-02, so off is low on both Connections.
